_about: RATIFIED Company Standard DATA-LOSS-EXCLUSION-MSA-001 (AM-163, 2026-10-19). The position is the
manager's statement of the company's intended data-loss exclusion, recorded verbatim in Legal
Constitution L1.14 section 9 (owner instruction, 2026-10-19: match it to the Constitution, update it
if absent). It is CONFIGURATION: no locked decision is amended by this file.
PRESENCE Requirement: it verifies that the provision EXISTS. A clause in which the provider takes
RESPONSIBILITY for data loss is read as a waiver of the position (AM-152), so it is a DEVIATION and a
person decides. The position's caveat is part of it: subject to applicable law and legal review;
Counsel must reconcile it with confidentiality, personal-data protection and other liability
exceptions; it must not be treated as excluding liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded.
description: Leapswitch is not liable for direct or indirect damages, including loss of data, arising from customer-supplied misinformation, misuse, third-party systems or incompatible configurations.

_terminology: Mapping terminology, ratified with the standard on 2026-10-19. Every term is drawn from the
Constitution's own wording of the position or names the clause type generically; no term encodes
a legal position (rules 7/21): the position lives in `configuration.expected_presence`, sourced
above. confirm_threshold 5 is STRUCTURAL: one exact phrase confirms; an alias or keyword group
scores 3, so two independent signals are always required. Waiver patterns are the provider
ACCEPTING the responsibility the position excludes — they are polarity terminology (35.4), and
none contains a negation, so "shall not be liable for data loss" is never one.
_legal_rule_note: PRIYEN'S RULE (owner 'change and update', 2026-11-16; replaces the zero-tolerance ruling of 2026-08-19/20 for client changes). Better for us or no change for us is accepted without a Legal Decision; only what is worse goes to Legal. MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE; a deviation -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal, except a deviation on this standard's declared favourable side (favourable_direction, from a source; never with favourable_counsel_check) -> ACCEPTABLE, still a DEVIATION (AM-239). No tolerance bands. effect_rule lets a client change the engine proves better or unchanged for us be accepted automatically, audited, reopenable by Legal.

configuration_before.position_statement: The provider is not liable for loss, deletion, corruption or unavailability of customer data, or its restoration costs, even where its own operational error caused the loss; infrastructure restoration and SLA service credits remain.
configuration_before._narrowing_note: G-F (owner, 2026-10-21): the position also covers 'a provider-side operational error, such as accidental deletion or decommissioning' (L1.14 §9). An exclusion limited to causes the customer or a third party brings is narrower — a DEVIATION for a person, never a match.
narrowing_causes: acts or omissions of the customer

msa_alignment.ruling: owner, 2026-11-16: "Do not change the whole Constitution. Only change the points that differ from Sayan's MSA. Sayan's MSA is the final verdict for now — point to point use Sayan's MSA." (rule 6 approval for these lock changes; AB-205)
msa_alignment.kind: DIFFERS — the MSA standard now states Sayan's MSA
msa_alignment.note: Sayan's 9.9 is limited to the causes it lists, so a cause-limited exclusion is the position, not a narrowing (the G-F narrowing check is withdrawn for this standard). A clause in which the provider accepts data-loss liability is still a waiver (AM-152).
